activity.notes: Geronimo (Goyakla/Goyathlay) was a Bedonkohe Chiricahua medicine man and renowned war leader, not a hereditary or formal chief of all Apache peoples. ATLAS therefore binds him to the narrower Chiricahua Apache political community and records the defining 1881-1886 resistance cycle from his 1881 breakout through the final surrender, rather than calling him sovereign ruler of a generic Apache polity.

sources.title: The Apache Wars Part II: Geronimo — U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service identifies Geronimo as a Bedonkohe Chiricahua medicine man who became a brilliant war leader, explicitly distinguishing him from a formal chief.

sources.title: Buffalo Soldiers, Geronimo, and Wounded Knee — Smithsonian National Museum of American History
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian records Geronimo's 1881 escape and continued resistance until his final surrender in 1886.
